failure.message: The managed package builder can clone, verify, and invoke the Arlen build, but the extracted staged toolchain still presents compiler flags that make clang reject -fobjc-arc as a legacy Objective-C runtime build.
failure.stderr_excerpt: error: -fobjc-arc is not supported on platforms using the legacy runtime

runner_fixes_applied: Avoided putting managed System/Library/Libraries on LD_LIBRARY_PATH before invoking host make, because that caused host make to load an incompatible managed libc.
Added a gnustep-config-only shim so package builds can use managed GNUstep metadata without picking up the staged managed clang wrapper from PATH.

next_actions.message: Run the package builder inside a fully relocated managed install root or fresh VM setup where gnustep-config emits modern libobjc2 runtime flags.
Add a preflight check that fails before compilation unless gnustep-config/clang can compile a minimal ARC Objective-C source.
